$comment: S339 (D-S339.2) — every origin a workflow VERIFIES AGAINST must have a declared publisher. See scripts/check-verification-origin-publisher.mjs. Adding an origin to a workflow without adding it here fails build:check.

origins.note: Production is published by the release lane itself (wrangler pages deploy, main branch); the ceremony verifies what that lane promoted.

S339: CI holds no Hetzner SSH credential and deliberately is not given one — a root key reachable from every workflow run is a blast-radius expansion that is the founder's call, not an agent's. The publisher therefore runs from an operator vantage, and surfaceParity gating (D-S339.1) is what makes drift block a release rather than pass unnoticed.
The Cloudflare Pages warm origin is written by the same lane that writes production.

$externalComment: Third-party APIs a workflow CALLS. They are not surfaces we publish, so they are exempt — but they must be listed here explicitly, so the exemption is a decision on the record rather than a silent skip.
